title: Explicit identity and credential lifecycle
description: Use isolated service and node identities to prove authentication, retirement, startup, transfer and browser login. Requires an agent-owned Chrome CDP port in FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT. No human credentials or live farm changes.

protocol.intent: Boot migration preserves authority; explicit admin id reuse keeps old secrets and stored work invalid while fresh pairing and newly authored queued work pass; stale invitations refuse without a store write. Operators and nodes cannot reuse ids.

startup.intent: Explicit credentials start the gateway and node, survive node rotation and restart, transfer files, and authenticate the browser through its real login form.

deployment-owner.intent: The deployment command retains the declared owner from the target instance, with explicit replacement and disable authoritative. Service rendering uses owned scratch, with remote effects stubbed.
